patronOf.en-US: Founder of Lérins, Archbishop of Arles
patronOf.pt-BR: Fundador de Lérins, Arcebispo de Arles

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The soul cannot truly serve God while it is involved in the distractions and pleasures of the world.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A alma não pode verdadeiramente servir a Deus enquanto está envolvida nas distrações e nos prazeres do mundo.

meta.face: A Gallo-Roman of about seventy-five with a light olive complexion and a face whose HIGH, BROAD, DOMED forehead is much larger than the SHORT, SMALL lower face — widely spaced, pale-blue eyes with gently drooping outer corners under thin, level white brows, a small, neat, straight nose, soft, full, rosy cheeks, a small mouth with a gentle smile, a small, rounded chin; the crown bald with a light fringe of white hair; a short, neat, rounded white beard close to the chin; a mild, fatherly gaze toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the sixteenth-century woodcut of the Occitan Vida de sant Honorat (Wikipedia lead image) shows only a mitred archbishop with a cross-staff. The book gives his consular Roman family, the island monastery of Lérins about 400 and his consecration for Arles in 426; his pupil Hilary praised the charity and concord of his community, hence the kindly, welcoming face. The domed, small-featured structure is our choice, kept apart from `hilary` (trapezoid) and `paulinus_nola` (heart-shaped, clean-shaven).
